QuestInfo.name: Savior of Ulu City
QuestInfo.0: There's only one monster left to defeat before Ulu City is saved! Quickly now. If you take too longer, the monsters you've already defeated will come back to life!
QuestInfo.1: You're so close to the end! Just defeat #b#o9420520##k, who #b#o9420513##k brought to Ulu City. \n\n#o9420522# #r#a45301##k
QuestInfo.2: You saved Ulu City and all the city's former residents finally returned home! You've learned an important moral from all of this: Treat nature with respect or she will show you her fury, and her fury gives you quite a headache.

0.0: Here's the deal. #o9420513# summoned #b#o9420520##k, the baddest goon in Ulu City, to terrorize us. Even I might have trouble against him, let alone YOU. I recommend you prove yourself against #o9420513# at least once if you want even a dream of a chance of surviving against #b#o9420520##k. You ready?
0.1: Make sure you've got everything you need to find #b#o9420520##k, including the #b#t4031942##k. Without it, you'll never find #b#o9420520##k.

yes.0: This is it. You have the tools to awaken #b#o9420520##k, but even I don't know how to use them... Trust your gut, and keep an eye out for the little monsters that #b#o9420520##k may summon to attack you.
yes.1: Only a wise adventurer can find the hidden entrance to get to #b#o9420520##k. Keep an eye out.
yes.2: Don't expect it to be easy. You have to pass the toughest part of the city before you get to #b#o9420520##k. Hope you live through it.

no.0: Giving up after you've come this far? Well, talk to #b#p9270030##k when you're ready to save Ulu City.

1.0: Stop wasting time! #b#o9420520##k could destroy not just Ulu City, but all of Singapore! Make sure that doesn't happen!

yes.0: Well, I'll be. You saved Ulu City! Maybe we should re-name our city after you.

mob.0: Well, you'll never find #b#o9420520##k without the #t4031942#. I'll have it ready for you when you're done hunting.
